name: xslt-transformer
description: Transform XML with XSLT 1.0–3.0 (Saxon-HE) and validate UBL 2.1 documents against XSD, EN16931 and Peppol BIS 3.0 — with errors traced back to the XSLT line that caused them. Only requires Java 11+.

ublValidator.validateOnSave.description: Validate UBL documents automatically when they are saved. Only files whose root element is a UBL document are validated.

enumDescriptions: Download the latest official rules for each document (cached; bundled rules are used when offline)
Only use the EN16931 and Peppol rules bundled with the extension; never download
ublValidator.rules.source.markdownDescription: Where business rules come from. With `latest`, the rules matching each document (EN16931, Peppol BIS, XRechnung, NLCIUS, France CTC, RO_CIUS, HR CIUS, Peppol PINT, ...) are downloaded from their official publishers and kept up to date.

ublValidator.rules.disabled.markdownDescription: Rule packs never to run, by id (e.g. `peppol-bis`, `en16931`, `fr-ctc`). Run **UBL: Show Business Rules** to see all ids.

ublValidator.rules.autoUpdate.description: Check downloaded rule packs for new versions once a day (in the background).

ublValidator.rules.catalogUrl.markdownDescription: Rules catalog fetched daily to pick up new countries and changed download locations without an extension update. Leave empty to use only the catalog bundled with the extension.

ublValidator.rules.allowedHosts.markdownDescription: Extra host names rule packs may be downloaded from, in addition to the official publishers (GitHub, docs.peppol.eu, mfinante.gov.ro, porezna.gov.hr).

ublValidator.rules.customSchematron.markdownDescription: Additional **compiled** Schematron rule files (XSLT producing SVRL) to run on every UBL document, e.g. XRechnung or other national CIUS rules. Relative paths are resolved against the first workspace folder.

ublValidator.artifactsPath.markdownDescription: Folder with replacement UBL XSD schemas and offline rules, using the same layout as the bundled `validation-artifacts` folder. Usually not needed: with `ublValidator.rules.source` set to `latest`, current rules are downloaded automatically.

ublValidator.javaPath.description: Path to the Java executable (Java 11 or newer). Leave empty to use "java" from PATH.

ublValidator.transformTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop a transform or validation that runs longer than this (e.g. a stylesheet stuck in an endless recursion).

ublValidator.rules.allowedRepos.markdownDescription: Extra GitHub repositories (`owner/name`) the remote rules catalog may download from, in addition to the publishers in the bundled catalog.

ublValidator.ai.provider.description: AI provider used for fix suggestions.

ublValidator.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model for the selected provider. Leave empty for the default: `gemini-2.5-flash` (Gemini), `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` (Groq), `claude-opus-5-5` (Anthropic), `gpt-5` (OpenAI).

ublValidator.ai.maxRetries.description: Maximum attempts per error when a fix does not resolve it.

ublValidator.ai.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for a single AI request.

ublValidator.ai.includeInputXml.description: Send the input XML to the AI provider for context. Turn off if input files contain data that must not leave your machine.

ublValidator.ai.maxInputXmlChars.description: Maximum characters of input XML sent to the AI provider; longer files are cut off (the model is told so).

enumDescriptions: Look up the sender and receiver whenever the Peppol Network panel is visible
Only look up when you click Check now
ublValidator.peppol.lookup.markdownDescription: When the **Peppol Network** panel looks up participants. Lookups query the Peppol SML (DNS), the participant's SMP and the Peppol Directory, and send the participant identifiers to them.

ublValidator.peppol.networks.description: Peppol networks to check participants on.
